notes.title: The House V1.9.5
notes.notes: Latest update for the first part of The House which fixes some issues/bugs

notes.title: The House V1.9.4
notes.notes: This update fixes some issues, such as void jumping. It also adds a new Main Menu.

notes.title: The House V.1.9.3
notes.notes:
This version fixes some issues with save games. Furthermore, from now on it will be possible to play with the controller (PS4/Xbox) without interruptions or bugs, just like the mouse and keyboard.

However, I remember that controller support remains partial

notes.title: The House V.1.9.2
notes.notes: This update fixes some issues with progress saves.

notes.title: The House Version 1.9.1
notes.notes: This update fixes all the game issues you reported!

notes.title: New update Versine 1.9
notes.notes:
This is the last update before part 2 of the game!
Other gameplay issues have been resolved in this update

notes.title: New Update Version 1.7
notes.notes:
This update further improves the gaming experience, thanks to the resolution of bugs such as: jumping with boxes and "jumping into the void".

We recommend joining our [url=https://discord.gg/jKYmfpBcc2]Discord server[/url] to learn more about future updates!

notes.title: The House Updated V.1.5
notes.notes: Some save game and gameplay errors have been resolved in this update. We hope that this way the gaming experience will improve further.
